S0426.reason: The contiguous zone is defined in UNCLOS as a zone where the coastal State may exercise control to prevent and punish infringement of customs, fiscal, immigration or sanitary laws.

S0432.reason: English courts may stay proceedings in cases of extra-territorial abduction, but only in rare circumstances, as established in cases like R v Horseferry Road Magistrates' Court, ex p Bennett.

S0450.reason: Walter George set the world record for the mile in 1886 with a time of 4:12.75.
